title: RunnerClaimRequest
description: Optional body of POST /api/runners/claim. The claim long-polls: 200 with a claim, or 204 after about pollSeconds when there is nothing to do.

maxQuality.description: The highest quality this runner trains right now; caps the hello's maxQuality (unknown: high).

maxBundleBytes.description: The largest bundle this runner downloads; values <= 0 or null mean no limit.

quality.description: Splat quality profile, lowest to highest.
